request.notes: Study dialsA2 of round 6 (round6/dials/dialsA2), declared in DECLARED.md at 3fd4076c5 (19:26 UTC) before any code. PILOT_NEVER_REUSE_AS_EXAM: truths are public pilot values (round 5's 8 and 8 drawn in the job by a public seed); the world secret is os.urandom and never written. One process (job.sh -> run_a2.py); dialsA's xlaw, a_nets, a_stats imported unchanged. (0) Presmoke at FULL SHAPES and small counts, same process: the law switch's zero point (64 members, one tick), 3 families of 512 episodes in chunks of 256, one truth at eta 0 and 4 plus one eta-1 world (Lab of 96 episodes, two exams of 48 items x 12 replicates), 6 conditioned block nets in lockstep on 6,144-episode sets (250 + 500 steps), fine-tunes 16 in lockstep at batch 64, D nets, every sampler and posterior; then a speed guard (exit 4 if the required stages do not fit the script's 3.6 h). (1) Truths 8-15: viability of 48 candidates. (2) Families public, true-form, designed: 768 points x 8 episodes each, 0.51 million member-ticks each. (3) 16 truths x eta 0/4: Lab of 96 episodes and two exams each, about 1.25 million member-ticks. (4) Inference S, H, H_mix (numpy). (5) Base nets: 6 in lockstep, 50 steps per dispatch (lax.scan), 24,000 steps, doubled while the training rule is unmet, at most 192,000; each doubling only if the presmoke's estimates leave time for the N = 8 stages. (6) N = 8: cross-validated fine-tunes (2 rates, held-out score every 10 steps to 400, 40 steps per dispatch, 16 in lockstep; grid widened at most twice), residual, S, H, H_mix, D(8); then N = 32 and an eta 1/2 arm on 4 truths if the clock allows. Expected 1.8-3.2 h on the script's clock from study A's rates on this card (r6-dialsa-003: about 1,300 member-ticks/s, 13.4 ms per step of the six base nets, 21.2 ms per lockstep fine-tune step); the base-net ladder is the main unknown. Memory: base-net data as A's (2.2 GB, largest array 2.3e8 elements); fine-tune step arrays 1.13e8 elements; check_elems refuses past 2^30, device arrays asserted below 2^31, data passed to the jitted functions as arguments; default allocator (the trainers now run 50 and 40 steps per dispatch, as the review of r6-dialsa-002 asked). Outputs 10-15 MB, all public, largest nets.npz about 3.5 MB. Exit codes: presmoke failure 1, speed guard 4, a failed part 2. Cap: $1.99/h x (3.9 + 0.25) h = $8.26, + $0.10 -> $8.40; the study's GPU cap is $12 in at most two jobs. CPU test: the whole job.sh at tiny shapes (presmoke, guard, full pass, exit 0) from a git archive of exactly these paths at the pinned ref (e0df0c079): presmoke, guard, full pass with a widened fine-tune grid, exit 0.
